photos.c: A Belgrave one-two in the European Games 100 metres! Silver for Dwain Chambers and gold for Darren Cambell.
Dwain Chambers gives Papadias some eyeball contact after the Greek dared to head the Belgrave man by 1/100th of a second in the 100 metres first round.
Left: Dwain Chambers, IAAF World Championships 100m Bronze Medallist for 1999.
Left: 100 metres World Championships Bronze Medallist Dwain Chambers enjoys the company of young Bretons in the stadium at Rennes.
Inside Back Page: Top left - As the finish nears in the final of the Olympic 100m, Dwain Chambers is inches ahead of USA's Jon Drummond but both just missed the medals.
Left: Dwain Chambers takes the 100 metres title by 1/100th of a second from Darren Campbell (out of shot), Lewis-Francis (Birchfield 239) and Gardener (Bath 151).
